title: Claude Code: Automate work with scheduled tasks
summary: A cloud scheduled task (formerly a routine) is a saved prompt with repositories and connectors that runs on a schedule, on an HTTP POST to its /fire endpoint with a bearer token (with optional text), or on GitHub events; each run is a new cloud session. Research preview; runs count against the account's limits.
ideas: An API trigger can start a fresh thread for an intent from any program.
A nightly run could compute every record's next action and post what waits.
